steps.title: A little space to play.
steps.description: Three small challenges. Six playful moments. Take them at your own pace — your answers are saved as you go.

steps.title: First, a little practice.
steps.description: Watch the blue cells. When they disappear, tap the same places. This practice helps you find your rhythm.

steps.title: Try seeing the whole shape.
steps.description: These three cells make a diagonal: top left, centre, bottom right. Remembering a shape can feel easier than remembering separate squares. In the rounds ahead, watch first, then rebuild it.

steps.title: A moment to remember.
steps.description: Look for the shape between the blue cells. Hold it in mind, then bring it back.

steps.title: One more fleeting pattern.
steps.description: A different arrangement, the same idea. Notice the gaps as well as the blue cells.

steps.title: Find the quiet rhythm.
steps.description: Look from left to right. Which shape belongs in the empty place?

steps.title: A pattern with a twist.
steps.description: Follow the direction of each arrow. Which way does the next one point?

steps.title: Everything in its place.
steps.description: Build a row that follows both clues. Tap two cards to swap them, use the arrow controls, or drag a card to its new place.
rules: The sun comes before the star.
The moon comes after the star.

steps.title: One last little untangle.
steps.description: Read the clues together. Rearrange the cards until each one has a place.
rules: The circle comes immediately after the leaf.

steps.title: Curiosity looks good on you.
steps.description: You made space to remember, notice and untangle. Here is the illustrative snapshot that closes your challenges.

steps.title:
A small pause.
A fresh perspective.
steps.description: You followed a pattern, found a rhythm and made a little order. Sometimes, a few moments of curiosity are enough.
